question: What happens when two black holes collide?
short_answer: When black holes collide, they merge into a single larger black hole, releasing immense energy as ripples in spacetime called gravitational waves.
full_explanation: LIGO directly observed the first black hole collision (GW150914) in 2015, where 3 solar masses of energy converted into gravitational waves in milliseconds.
